title: SPEC A implementation: config staging/live promotion

completion_criteria.text: SPEC A section 7's five cutover preconditions are all closed and verified, with the *session* gitignore pattern narrowed BEFORE the hook file it hides is adopted.
The promote verb is implemented with pre-swap validation, rollback by rename, and the LIVE receipt, and the bootstrap resolves outside releases/.
SessionStart and Stop converge hooks are registered, and a drift report reaches session context when live differs from main.
The settings.json ownership manifest and the separate capture verb are implemented, with unknown keys defaulting to LIVE WINS and flagged rather than dropped.
The cutover runs serially in a session doing nothing else: the first release is built and validated with zero live change, then every entry link is swapped in one pass.
All 10 of SPEC A's acceptance criteria pass, with criterion 10 verified by diffing the live tree against the release rather than asserted.
Every unit ships through a PR opened by pr.mjs pr-create, stacked with --base <parent-branch> where one change blocks another.

spine.active_goal: Implement and ship SPEC A (config staging/live promotion) as stacked PRs, landing the invariant inert basis and chore/config-drift ahead of SPEC A's own units.
spine.next_step: Land the units in this order: (1) feat/invariant-inert-registry, dispatched 2026-08-06, adds inert_when to docs/invariants/registry.json so later PRs record a machine-checked basis instead of 17 prose verdicts; (2) chore/config-drift as the stack root PR, which makes SPEC A tracked and citable; (3) SPEC A's units per 0275's three bands. Stack with pr.mjs pr-create --base <parent-branch> and retarget each child by hand once its parent merges, since deleteBranchOnMerge is false.
spine.last_session: Recon only, no code. Confirmed the live census and found the leak blocker: 5 of the 64 files to be adopted carry the confidential codename and this repo is public. Recorded 0276 and 0277, then dispatched the inert-basis unit.

open_risks.text: Serialize every write to a live-linked path, not just the cutover — the graphify hook edits and the converge-hook registration reach running sessions through the 26 hook symlinks, so a half-saved file breaks every session instantly.

Run the cutover serially in a session doing nothing else — it hot-swaps live-linked hooks, lib and workflows, so parallel subagents editing those paths can break every running session including the one doing the work.

SPEC section 2 is stale against 0276 — it draws eleven entry links and says notes is one of them, but notes is now live-only, so the layout is ten entry links plus one pointer and acceptance criterion 10's diff must exclude local/ or it fails for the wrong reason.

Adoption is publication and is irreversible — the repo is public, so every coverage-gap commit runs the codename scan before it is pushed, and the 2026-07-19 rejection of committing untracked paths wholesale still stands.

An inert_when glob that is too wide silently weakens the gate for every future PR — it would let a change that really does reach an invariant record a machine-checked basis instead of a verdict, so narrow beats convenient.

key_decisions.title: SPEC A is implemented and shipped by a dedicated small dynamic workflow, with stacked PRs for blocking changes
The workflow fan-out boundary is any write to a live-linked path, not the cutover alone
Three plans are scrubbed at source; notes/ is reclassified live-only and never enters a release
chore/config-drift is the stack root and the inert basis lands before SPEC A's units

out_of_scope: Building SPEC B Part IV's stacked-PR machinery to serve this work - stacking here is manual via the convention, and 0271 orders SPEC A to land before any SPEC B unit
Editing mitosis.js or the parallel engine, which SPEC B governs
